entries.zh: 俊秀：才貌出众、俊雅秀异；亦指才俊之士
entries.en: virtue and wisdom (Sp. headword cut off at 'sabid-'); Chin. 'junxiu': handsome and talented, outstanding
entries.notes: 西语词头截断（'sabid-'），按 sabiduría 补足属推断；汉栏'俊秀'与音写 chun siu 互证清晰。

entries.zh: 应验：（预言、祷告）应验、灵验有效；西语兼指圣髑之灵验功效
entries.en: to come true, prove efficacious; the (miraculous) virtue of a relic
entries.notes: 'vd' 为缩写，'Virtud vd de reliquia' 之展开系推断；与汉栏'应验'互证灵验义。

entries.zh: 〔字义存疑〕應后：组词罕见、义未能定；或谓应验于后／应候（应时而验）
entries.en: 'eng hou' — sense not determinable; possibly 'to come true afterwards / in due season'
entries.notes: 汉栏'應后'非常用词，第二字音注污损（T99），语义无法定夺。

entries.zh: 福德：福泽与德行；善报福分
entries.en: blessings and virtue; felicity, blessedness (Sp. 'virtudes' plural inferred from broken headword)
entries.notes: 词头 'virtud. ides' 按断行 virtudes（诸德）展开，属推断；汉栏'福德'与音写 hof teg 互证清晰。

entries.zh: 珠：痘疮疱粒，指天花脓疱（闽俗谓'出珠'）；词条后半音写污损难辨
entries.en: smallpox pustules ('pearls', Chin. usage); latter part of the phonetic line smudged/illegible
entries.notes: 音写含 [疑:hur/hun] 与难解残段 'sabi'，仅'珠=痘疱'一义可定。

entries.zh: 癣：疥癣、皮肤癣疮
entries.en: smallpox (per Sp. headword 'viruelas'); the Chinese equivalent reads 'tinea/ringworm' — pairing loose
entries.notes: 西语词头 viruelas（天花）与汉栏'癣'配合不密，疑词头串行或原书如此，故降中置信。

entries.zh: 水痘：水痘（西语词头并举天花与麻疹）
entries.en: smallpox and measles (Sp.); Chin. equivalent: chickenpox (water pox)

entries.zh: 水癬：水疱状皮疹（近水痘一类发疹）；第二字音写存疑
entries.en: smallpox and measles (Sp.); Chin. 'watery eruption/blisters' (partly doubtful reading)
entries.notes: 音写 [疑:lun/lou] 存疑，汉栏'水癬'可辨，取'水疱皮疹'义。

entries.zh: 班：斑点、痘疮瘢斑（'班'通'斑'）
entries.en: virulent (of eruptions, Sp.); Chin. 'ban': spots, pockmarks

entries.zh: 班皮：斑驳粗糙之皮（疮疱后留斑之皮）
entries.en: virulent (Sp.); Chin. 'ban pi': blotched/scurfy skin

entries.zh: 癣迹：癣疮愈后所留痕迹、瘢迹
entries.en: virulent (Sp.); Chin. 'lun chia': traces/marks left by tinea or sores

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: [original defective; gloss uncertain]
entries.notes: 四栏皆空（版面空位），无从取义。

entries.zh: 〔字形存疑，勢/執两可〕势：威势、权势；或执：持执——与词头'探访'配合未详
entries.en: (character doubtful: shi 'power/influence' or zhi 'to hold'); Sp. 'to visit the …' ('fugil' unresolved)
entries.notes: 汉栏有 [疑:勢/執]，西语末词 'fugil' 难解（疑为 fugitivo 之讹），语义无法定夺。

entries.zh: 语：说话、告语；条下系'探访'义，谓访晤言谈
entries.en: to visit, call on (Sp.); Chin. 'yu' (語): to speak, tell — loose pairing
entries.notes: 词头'探访'与'语'配合较松（或涉形近字如'謁'），不敢遽断，降中置信。

entries.zh: 探：探访、探问
entries.en: to visit suddenly / drop in on (Sp.); Chin. 'tam' (探): to call on, probe

entries.zh: 朝：朝见、朝拜君主
entries.en: to visit the king — to pay homage, attend court (Chin. 'chao' 朝)

entries.zh: 见：见面、谒见；看望
entries.en: to visit, to see (Sp.); Chin. 'jian' (見): to see, meet

entries.zh: 参：参谒、参见（君主尊长）
entries.en: to visit the king; Chin. 'can' (參): to call in homage, pay respects

entries.zh: 询：询问、探询；查问
entries.en: to visit the laborers and question them (Sp.); Chin. 'xun' (詢): to inquire, interrogate
entries.notes: 音写尾段污损且有 [疑:h/l]，仅'询=问'一义可定；R 栏西语注 'Sondar u deistrillo'（探询）互证。

entries.zh: 察：察看、视察；访察
entries.en: to visit as on inspection (Sp.); Chin. 'cha' (察): to inspect, observe

entries.zh: 勘：查勘、勘验、核查
entries.en: to inspect (Sp. perh. 'con su vista', by view — reading uncertain); Chin. 'kan' (勘): to examine, verify
entries.notes: 音写多出 'giam utd yu' 段未详（giam 或为'验'，utd 似缩写）；R 栏西语注 'lado:' 与词条关系不明。

entries.zh: 望：探望、看望（病人）
entries.en: to visit the sick (Sp. tail 'o san[…]' cut off); Chin. 'wang' (望): to visit, look to
entries.notes: 西语词条尾部残断（'o san[残]'，或为 sanar/sanos），核心义'探望病人'可定，因 [残] 依规降低置信。
